title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the functional student-preferred spaces at CCNY, from quiet library corners to active student centers and specialized lounges.

cards.title: Hoffman Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: North Academic Center (NAC), 1st Floor
cards.notes: Located near the Convent Avenue entrance, this lounge features a game room and social seating. It is a primary hub for students to relax between classes in the NAC.
cards.short_summary: A central social lounge and game room located on the first floor of the North Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hoffman Lounge is located on the first floor of the NAC and includes a game room for student use.
cards.source_title: LGBTQ+ Student Center - Contact Us - The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Open to CCNY students with valid ID during building hours.

cards.title: Music Library
cards.subtitle: Shepard Hall, Room 160
cards.notes: A quiet, wood-paneled retreat in historic Shepard Hall. It offers 10 Mac stations and a vast collection of scores and recordings for focused study.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library in Shepard Hall known for its quiet atmosphere and extensive music resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Music Library is located in Shepard Hall Room 160 and provides Mac stations and study space.
cards.source_title: Facilities | The City College of New York - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday; check library website for seasonal hours.

cards.title: Wingate Gaming Room
cards.subtitle: Wingate Hall, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Equipped with console and PC stations, this room serves as a dedicated space for the campus esports community and casual gaming.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated student gaming facility located on the second floor of Wingate Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gaming Room in Wingate Hall features console and PC stations for student use.
cards.source_title: Gaming Room - Wingate Center: Student Center at City College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Valid CCNY ID required for entry and equipment use.

cards.title: Michael Sorkin Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Spitzer School of Architecture, Room 101
cards.notes: A light-filled space housing the personal collection of Professor Michael Sorkin. It features a long seminar table ideal for quiet reading and conversation.
cards.short_summary: A specialized architectural reading room and study space in the Spitzer School of Architecture.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sorkin Reading Room opened in 2023 and is located within the Architecture Library at the Spitzer School.
cards.source_title: Sorkin Reading Room - The Bernard and Anne Spitzer School of Architecture
cards.access_notes: Accessible to CCNY members during Architecture Library hours.

cards.title: cITy Tech Center
cards.subtitle: NAC, 1st Floor (Room 1/301)
cards.notes: A massive computing hub with over 300 workstations and reservable media study rooms. It is the go-to spot for group projects and printing.
cards.short_summary: The primary student computing and technology center located on the ground floor of the Cohen Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tech Center in NAC 1/301 offers over 300 workstations and reservable media study rooms.
cards.source_title: Research and Study Facilities | City College Catalog - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Reservations for study rooms can be made in person at the center.

cards.title: MCA Lounge
cards.subtitle: Shepard Hall, 4th Floor
cards.notes: A bright lounge area under a glass ceiling used by Media and Communication Arts students. It features couches and tables for casual meetings.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge in Shepard Hall known for its natural light and social atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The MCA Lounge is located on the 4th floor of Shepard Hall and serves as a social and study space.
cards.source_title: MCA Facilities | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Open during Shepard Hall academic hours.

cards.title: Science & Engineering Library Quiet Room
cards.subtitle: Marshak Building, Room 29
cards.notes: Tucked away in the Marshak Building, this library offers a silent environment preferred by STEM students for intensive focus.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study area within the Science & Engineering Library in the Marshak Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Science & Engineering Library is located in Marshak Room 29 and provides quiet study space.
cards.source_title: Directions to Library Buildings - CCNY Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday; check for specific library hours.

cards.title: Wingate Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Wingate Hall, 3rd Floor
cards.notes: A renovated historic gymnasium offering cardio and strength equipment. It is a popular spot for students to stay active between lectures.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus fitness facility located on the third floor of Wingate Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wingate Fitness Center is located on the 3rd floor of Wingate Hall and is open to the CCNY community.
cards.source_title: CCNY Campus Fitness and Recreation | The City College of New York - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Valid CCNY ID required; open until 8:00 PM Monday-Thursday.

cards.title: The Writing Center
cards.subtitle: NAC, 3rd Floor (Amsterdam Plaza Entrance)
cards.notes: Beyond tutoring, this center provides a quiet computer lab with 26 Macs. It is a useful alternative to the main library for writing-intensive work.
cards.short_summary: An academic support center in the NAC providing tutoring and a quiet computer lab.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writing Center is located on the 3rd floor of the NAC and includes a computer lab for student use.
cards.source_title: The Writing Center - The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Friday is Zoom only.

cards.title: NAC Ballroom
cards.subtitle: North Academic Center, 1st Floor
cards.notes: A large multipurpose space used for student club events, cultural shows, and occasionally as an overflow study area during peak times.
cards.short_summary: A versatile event and gathering space on the first floor of the North Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The NAC Ballroom is a key venue for student life activities and is located on the first floor of the NAC.
cards.source_title: Student Life - The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Access depends on scheduled events; check the Student Life calendar.
